messages:
Elaine (CS): Heads up — BrimCore trial showing p95 ~2.1s with noticeable tail during 11am-2pm window. Traffic is lots of short requests (<=80 tokens) plus a smaller fraction of long completions. Recommend: int8 quant on default model + routing short queries to compact-v1-int8 and long queries to base-v2-fp16. Thoughts? cc @raf @jun

Jun (Solutions): That sounds reasonable. Can we run our eval set first to quantify quality delta? Last int8 run bumped fuzz in the `summarize` prompts.

Raf (Eng-runtime): I can spin up an A/B on 10k recent requests from their trial. Proposed routing rule in Console: if prompt_tokens < 80 -> compact-v1-int8, else -> base-v2-fp16. Also enable prefix KV caching for session-based flows to cut repeated prefix cost.

Elaine (CS): Helpful — will customers see any billing or token changes? CS wants a one-pager to explain impact before the renewal touch.

Jun (Solutions): Billing units unchanged; int8 reduces compute cost per-token. Routing shifts which model handles tokens, but net should lower unit cost. We'll capture delta in the A/B report.

Matt (CS-Mgr): BrimCore flagged latency as a renewal risk in the last QBR. Can we 1) validate no meaningful quality regression, 2) show expected p95 improvement, and 3) make the canary visible in the Console for PMs? If yes, schedule a 30m with their PM pls.

Elaine (CS): Done. Booked 2026-09-15 11:00am PT with BrimCore PM. Raf — can you paste the Console routing snippet and quick A/B numbers here after the run?

Raf (Eng-runtime): Will do. Quick preview of my local A/B (synthetic 2k queries):
```
A/B summary:
- baseline (base-v2-fp16): p95 = 2100ms, avg = 320ms, hallucination-rate (eval set) = 0.9%
- compact-v1-int8: p95 = 730ms, avg = 180ms, hallucination-rate = 1.1%
- recommended split routing (auto): effective p95 ~= 820ms, avg ~= 200ms, est cost delta = -42%
```
Console routing example (can paste into Route editor):
```json
{
  "name": "brimcore-short-long-split",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens < 80", "route": "compact-v1-int8"},
    {"else": "base-v2-fp16"}
  ],
  "canary": {"duration": "48h", "percent": 20}
}
```

deploy-bot: canary created brimcore-int8-canary-8050001123

Jun (Solutions): If the A/B quality delta is within threshold (<=0.5% absolute), propose 48h canary then full rollout. Make sure to save the eval set + baseline snapshots for rollback gating.

Elaine (CS): :thumbsup: I'll capture live feedback during the PM call and surface any prompt patterns that regress. tagging #enablement for a short demo slide on what to expect.

Raf (Eng-runtime): After the A/B finishes I'll upload the detailed logs and the route snippet to the thread. Also enabling KV cache should further reduce p50 on session-heavy flows.

Jun (Solutions): Note — for any summarization-heavy endpoints, we should run an extra focused eval. I'll prepare a small test harness.

Matt (CS-Mgr): Thanks team. This should help the renewal conversation if we can show a clear p95 improvement and flat quality.

Elaine (CS): Agree. Next steps: Raf runs A/B (eta 4h), Jun preps focused eval (eta EOD), I run customer call 9/15. I'll post a short README for the PM before the meeting.
